description: Land Title Settlement Department - Meerigama, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510200
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, cadastral mapping details, and ownership registration. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership information, extents, and property characteristics, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
